_comment: Input data for Assignment 2, in reduced Lennard-Jones units (epsilon = sigma = 1). Entries named _comment explain the data and are not used.

_comment.use: triangular lattice for Q1, Q2 and Q4; PBC in x and y; potential phi_LJ truncated at r_cut
_comment.periodic_cells: one entry per cell size NxN; fields explained below
_comment.Lx, Ly: periodic box runs from (0, 0) to (Lx, Ly); use these values, not ones from a rounded a
_comment.removed_atom_position: site of the vacancy in vacancy_NxN.csv
_comment.removed_atom_id_in_perfect: id of that atom in perfect_NxN.csv
_comment.interstitial_position: starting position of the extra atom in interstitial_NxN.csv
_comment.interstitial_atom_id: id of the extra atom (last line of interstitial_NxN.csv)

q1_q2_q4.potential: phi_LJ(r) = 4(r^-12 - r^-6), truncated at r_cut with the cutoff correction

_comment.use: square lattice for Q3; no PBC; potential phi_sq truncated at r_cut
_comment.eps2, r2, s: depth, centre and width of the Gaussian well in phi_sq
_comment.lattice_spacing_a: nearest-neighbour distance a of the square lattice
_comment.N: number of atoms in the file
_comment.groups: atoms per group; top and bottom (two rows each) are constrained, mobile atoms are relaxed
_comment.burgers_vector: Burgers vector b of the edge dislocation
_comment.slip_plane_y: y coordinate of the slip plane
_comment.extra_half_column_ids: ids of the extra half-column atoms (last 14 lines of the file)
_comment.displacement_increment: increment of the horizontal displacement of the top group
_comment.final_displacement: largest displacement of the top group

q3.potential: phi_sq(r) = phi_LJ(r) - eps2*exp(-(r - r2)^2/(2 s^2)), truncated at r_cut with the cutoff correction
q3.boundary: no PBC; left and right surfaces free; top and bottom groups constrained
